game_title: Break Out – Mine Cart Tunnel Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel, an old mine cart tunnel: the torchbearer must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Break Out: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel: an old mine cart tunnel
core_gameplay_loop: In Mine Cart Tunnel, repeat each round: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted. Each round, shadow wraiths strike the mine cart, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the alert value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the mine cart from shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel: keep the alert meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: alert drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Break Out
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
